rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken pronoun for “us,” whether the group includes the listener or refers to an associated group; it also stands alone as an answer.

example.english: They’re waiting for us, so let’s go eat together.
example.traditional: 佢哋等緊我哋，我哋一齊去食飯啦。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 dang2 gan2 ngo5 dei6 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 sik6 faan6 laa1

rows.note: Use this when “us” is the complement of the copula, as in “It’s us.”

example.jyutping: hai6 ngo5 dei6 hoi1 mun4 laa1
